newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on institutional support.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on institutional support.

text.p: Support from a state-run investment bank helped Dhaka stocks stage a quick recovery from previous session's panic to finish slightly up on Saturday, brokers said.

The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange closed 1.08 points or 0.12 percent up at 1,139.54 on a turnover of 48.2 million taka. Of 116 traded issues, 75 gained, 38 lost and 3 unchanged. Panicky investors fled on Thursday when the Securities Exchange Commission (SEC) filed cases against leading brokers and companies after an inquiry report charged them with price rigging.
Beximco Pharma lost 4.61 taka to 141.41 and Shine Pukur Holdings rose 1.93 to 153.93. Friday is weekend in Bangladesh.
